info.title: Restaurant OS API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS restaurant platform — backend API.

deviceSecret.description: 3A: ADMIN-surface device secret. Required for admin/manager login unless the caller is the Owner (break-glass) or the restaurant allows unanchored admin login.

allBranches.description: True if the caller is restaurant-wide (their role applies at every branch).

accessibleBranches.description: Branches the caller can access, each with effective permissions.

roleId.description: Role id (must belong to the same organization).

branchId.description: Optional branch scope within the restaurant.

roleId.description: Reassign to a role in the same organization.

restaurantId.description: Change restaurant scope (must belong to the org).

branchId.description: Branch the role applies at (must be in the restaurant).

roleId.description: Role id granted at this branch (same organization).

permissions.description: Permission keys; validated against the catalog.
Replaces the full permission set; validated against the catalog.

secret.description: Plaintext device secret — shown once, never retrievable again.

pin.description: Plaintext PIN — shown once to the manager.

mustRotate.description: True if the staff member must rotate the PIN (after a reset).

userId.description: The user chosen from the branch staff picker.

branchId.description: The branch the device is bound to (send as X-Branch-Id).

mustRotate.description: True if this PIN was reset and should be rotated.

allowUnanchoredAdminLogin.description: 3A: admin login allowed from any device when true.

allowManualTableStatus.description: Manual table status changes allowed (vs flow-driven).

enableCustomerOrdering.description: Allow customers to submit dine-in order requests (needs enableQrMenu).

allowUnanchoredAdminLogin.description: 3A: when false (default), admin/manager email login must come from an enrolled ADMIN-surface device. Owner is always exempt (break-glass).

isDefault.description: Whether this is the restaurant default branch.

ipBindingMode.description: 3A: STRICT enforces ipAllowlist on device-anchored logins; SOFT records + trusts.

ipAllowlist.description: 3A: allowed source CIDRs (or bare IPs) evaluated under STRICT.

categoryId.description: Category id (must belong to your restaurant).
Reassign to another category in your restaurant.

groupId.description: Id of a library modifier group in this branch.

groupIds.description: Attached group ids in the desired order.

priceDeltaAmount.description: Price delta in minor units. May be 0 or negative (a discount).

optionIds.description: Option ids in the desired order.

priceDeltaAmount.description: Price delta in minor units. May be 0 or negative.

floorId.description: Floor id (must belong to your restaurant).
Move to another floor in your restaurant.

tableId.description: Required for DINE_IN on a table.

deviceSecret.description: Enrolled POS device secret (the step-up first factor).

value.description: PERCENT -> basis points; FIXED -> minor units.

approvedByUserId.description: Approver user id (required if approvals are enforced).

authorization.description: Manager step-up authorization. Required ONLY when the caller lacks DISCOUNT_APPLY — a capable manager authorizes the discount with their PIN on the enrolled POS device. Omit when the caller already holds DISCOUNT_APPLY.

approvedByUserId.description: Approver user id (required if approvals are enforced).

amount.description: Amount applied to the bill (minor units).

tenderedAmount.description: Cash tendered (>= amount); used only to compute change.

parts.description: Number of even shares to split the total into.

remainder.description: Remainder distributed to the first shares.

itemIds.description: Item ids to move to a new linked check.

elapsedSeconds.description: Seconds since the item was sent to the kitchen.

tableId.description: Assign a table (plan only; no live hold).

customerNote.description: Optional free-text note from the customer.

businessHours.description: Business hours, if configured. Opaque JSON for the client to render.

reservedAt.description: Requested date+time (ISO 8601). Must be in the future.

token.description: Plaintext device token. Shown once; store it now.

message.description: Reason for a skip/error (null when imported).

rowCount.description: Total data rows in the file (header excluded).

duplicateCount.description: Of errorCount, how many were skipped duplicates.

branchId.description: Single resolved branch, or null when the file spanned branches.

note.description: Structural failure reason (e.g. missing columns); null otherwise.

totalRevenueAmount.description: Sum of line totals (minor units). NON-FISCAL.

branchSlug.description: BR-9: the table's branch slug (fetch this branch's menu).

lastUnitCostMicro.description: Last unit cost at MICRO precision (BigInt as string).

consumptionLocationId.description: 6C: per-item consumption location (null => branch default Main Storage).

factor.description: Base units per one of this unit (e.g. kg -> 1000).

locationId.description: Target location id; omit or null to reset to the branch default (Main Storage).

unitCostMicro.description: Derived unit cost at MICRO precision (BigInt as string).

remainingValue_amount.description: Derived costed value of the remaining qty.

itemId.description: Inventory item id (must belong to your restaurant).

unit.description: Base unit (e.g. "GRAM") or a defined alternate name (e.g. "kg").

qty.description: Quantity in the entered unit (positive integer).

lineTotalCost_amount.description: Total paid for this line, in integer minor units.

expiryDate.description: Batch expiry (only when the item tracks expiry).

locationId.description: 6C: target inventory location for the received stock (defaults to Main Storage).

receivedAt.description: When goods were received (defaults to now).

itemId.description: Inventory item id (must belong to your restaurant).

unit.description: Base unit (e.g. "GRAM") or a defined alternate name (e.g. "kg").

qty.description: Quantity in the entered unit (positive integer).

wentNegative.description: True if an OUT drove on-hand negative (warn, not blocked).

uncosted.description: True if the entry could not be costed.

itemId.description: Inventory item id (must belong to your restaurant + branch).

locationId.description: Location id where the count was taken.

unit.description: Base unit (e.g. "GRAM") or a defined alternate name (e.g. "kg").

countedQty.description: The ACTUAL counted quantity in the entered unit (>= 0).

reason.description: Optional reason / note for the correction.

uncosted.description: True if a positive correction could not be costed.

lowStockRaised.description: True if the correction crossed at/below the low-stock threshold.

baseQty.description: Quantity in the item base unit consumed per 1× batch.

itemId.description: Output item id (MUST be of kind PROCESSED).

isPrimary.description: Absorbs 100% of cost when no shares set.

processingCost_amount.description: Per-run processing cost in minor units.

runAt.description: When the run occurred (defaults to now).

baseQty.description: Consumed per 1 unit of the dish (base unit).

modifierOptionId.description: Modifier option id (existing menu modifier option).

itemId.description: Inventory item consumed when this option is selected.

baseQty.description: Extra quantity consumed per dish unit (base unit).

menuItemId.description: Menu item this recipe is for (one recipe per item).

unit.description: ITEM: base unit or a defined alternate unit name.

qty.description: ITEM: quantity in the entered unit.

menuItemId.description: DISH: menu item id whose recipe is exploded.

occurredAt.description: When the loss occurred (defaults to now).

isSystem.description: System locations (Main Storage / Kitchen / Bar) cannot be deleted.

name.description: Location (shelf) name, unique within the branch.

quantity.description: On-hand in base units (may be negative).

itemId.description: Inventory item id (must belong to your restaurant + branch).

unit.description: Base unit (e.g. "GRAM") or a defined alternate name (e.g. "kg").

qty.description: Quantity in the entered unit (positive integer).

unitCostMicro.description: Carrying unit cost (MICRO precision, BigInt as string).

conflictStrategy.description: On key collision: SKIP (leave) or OVERWRITE (reconcile to match).

include.description: Comma-separated / array of sections to clone. Omit for all.

priceAmount.description: Price in integer minor units (e.g. cents).

password.description: Optional. If omitted, a strong password is generated and returned once.

ownerPassword.description: Returned ONCE. Generated if no password was supplied.

paymentsEnabled.description: No payment processing yet — billing/payments integration pending.

branchId.description: The branch this hub will serve.

lastHeartbeatAt.description: When the hub last sent a heartbeat.

healthStatus.description: Live health (OFFLINE derived from heartbeat recency).

online.description: True if a heartbeat arrived within the offline threshold.

updateAvailable.description: True if the hub is behind the cloud schema/app version.

token.description: The plaintext node token. Shown ONCE — store it on the hub now.

lastHeartbeatAt.description: When the hub last sent a heartbeat.

healthStatus.description: Live health (OFFLINE derived from heartbeat recency).

online.description: True if a heartbeat arrived within the offline threshold.

updateAvailable.description: True if the hub is behind the cloud schema/app version.

id.description: The OutboxEntry id (echoed back in appliedIds).

lastConfigSyncedAt.description: When config last synced from cloud (ISO).

lastPushedSeq.description: Highest outbox edgeSeq acked by the cloud.

pendingOutboxCount.description: Pending edge→cloud outbox entries on the hub.

dbStatus.description: Local DB status as the hub sees it.
